BETWEEN:-
 RAHUL PAL S/O SHRI ANIL KUMAR PAL, AGED
ABOUT  24 YEARS, OCCUPATION: STUDENT R/O VILLAGE  VILLAGE TIKRI HARAKHPUR POLICE STATION

MANDHATA DISTRICT PRATAPGADH (UTTAR  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI RAM SHARAN RATHORE - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION SAMAN DISTRICT REWA (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI K.S. BAGHEL - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)

This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.8/2022, registered at Police Station-Saman,
District-Rewa (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 420, 34 of the IPC.
2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 11.01.2023.
Applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case diary.
There is no evidence available against him in the case diary.
In view of same, applicant may be released on bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.
It is submitted that applicant along with other co- accused person targeted weak, old and infirm people.
They followed them to ATM Card Machine and noted their password and during transaction used to change their ATM Cards.
Later On, ATM Card and password were used to withdraw the money.
Two more cases are registered against the applicant.
Applicant is habitual offender.

sentences.text: Applicant was specifically targeting weak, old and senior citizen, therefore, bail application may be dismissed.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5.
Evidence is available against one Sanjay.
On basis of his memorandum, ATM Card of Kamalbhan has been recovered from him.
So far as, present applicant is concerned only memorandum of co-accused and his own memorandum are available.
No recovery has been made from him pursuant to his disclosure statement.
No other evidence is available against him.

6. Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that applicant is in jail since 11.01.2023 and trial will take considerable time for its conclusion, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, bail application filed by applicant is allowed on condition that applicant will mark his present before concerned police station i.e. Saman, District-Rewa (MP) twice of every month i.e. first and fifteenth day of the month.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on aforesaid condition on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on the dates to be fixed by the trial court.
8. The applicant shall also abide by the conditions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. C.C. as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE shabana Rahul Pal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65436708/
